siteTitle: ANS · Learn AI and make something of your own
siteDescription: AI learning for beginners: learn a method, organize real project facts, generate resume bullets, a README and a project overview, then edit, save and reuse them.
siteKeywords: AI learning,AI for beginners,AI tools,project results,resume,README
eyebrow: ANS · Your first result with AI
heroTitle: Learn an AI method. Make something of your own.
heroDescription: Start with a real project. Follow the guide, record the facts, generate a project overview, README and resume bullets, then review and edit them yourself.
lessonTitle: Lesson 1: Ask AI to organize facts, not invent experience
lessonDescription: This is a teaching example, not a customer story. It does not populate your project or use credits.
exampleInput: Example facts: textbook exchange information is scattered; I gathered requirements using a form; no measured result or evidence yet.
exampleOutput: Example draft: Gathered requirements through a form to address scattered textbook exchange information. Impact has not been measured; evidence is still needed.
exampleWarning: Do not turn this into ‘served thousands of users and improved efficiency by 80%’: those facts were never provided.
step1Title: 1. Learn the method and record facts
step1Body: Describe the problem, your contribution, method, result and evidence. Mark unknowns explicitly.
step2Body: Choose resume bullets, a README or a one-page overview. Review the credit cost first and reuse the same facts.
step3Body: Check claims, edit online, save a new version and download it. AI output is not verified fact.
libraryTitle: Your existing prompts, templates and workflows remain available
libraryBody: Use these supporting resources when needed, after completing your first project.
projectsDescription: One set of facts, three useful drafts. Finish one project before starting the next method.
privateHint: Project facts are owner-only. Generation and editing never publish your results automatically.
createFailed: Could not create the project. Please try again.
emptyTitle: Start with something you have done
emptyBody: Use coursework, an internship task or a personal project. If you have none, read the example first; do not copy its experience.
factsHint: Mark missing information explicitly. Confirming inputs does not verify AI output.
hintProblem: What real problem did you face?
hintContribution: Only describe work you actually did.
hintMethod: Methods you used, not planned ones.
hintResult: Only provable results. Mark missing data explicitly.
hintEvidence: Repository, document or demo; mark missing evidence explicitly.
factsSaved: Facts saved. You can generate a draft.
factsConfirmed: Facts confirmed. AI output still needs review.
operationFailed: The operation failed. Please try again.
generated: New draft saved. Review and edit it; regenerating preserves previous versions.
cost: Each generation costs {points} credits, including regeneration. Manual edits and downloads use no generation credits.
noArtifacts: No drafts yet. Record facts, then choose a result to generate.
draftWarning: Check your contribution, numbers and evidence. Remove invented methods or results. Save your edits first: downloads exclude unsaved changes.
versionHint: Generation and manual edits append versions without overwriting old content.
editSaved: Edits saved as a new version. Review is still required; nothing was published automatically.
sharingHint: This separate action applies only to the selected version. Check privacy, copyright and facts first; other versions and project facts stay private.
shareAck: I reviewed this version and agree to submit it for public review.
shareSubmitted: Request submitted. Nothing is public until approval.
